stories.title: Goldman Sachs is pulling Claude Code from its bankers and traders
stories.reason: Goldman restricted Claude Code/GitHub Copilot for traders & bankers after a productivity/risk review; real enterprise-deployment pullback, not a rumor.
key_facts: Internal guidance updated Oct 2026 bars most traders/bankers from Claude Code and GitHub Copilot; 'strats' keep access
Follows an earlier Apr 2026 Hong Kong-only Claude removal over contract terms
Goldman and Morgan Stanley are lead underwriters on Anthropic's expected Nasdaq IPO (ticker ANT) before end of Nov 2026
Barclays, by contrast, expects half its developers using Claude Code by year-end

stories.title: How We Took Over ChatGPT Accounts
stories.reason: Full technical account of an exploit chain that could take over ChatGPT accounts via the artifacts/Canvas sandbox; real PoC-level detail, fixed, bounty paid.
key_facts: Chain: MathLive virtual-keyboard postMessage handler used innerHTML to escape the sandboxed artifacts iframe
CSP allowed scripts from a few domains including YouTube, whose oEmbed endpoint reflected attacker JS
Resulting ChatGPT share URL could exfiltrate a victim's private data or act on their behalf when opened
Found by Parameter Labs, OpenAI paid a $5,000 bounty (called 'a bit cheap' by Simon Willison for the severity)

stories.title: Unlocking any car from X brand in most of the world
stories.reason: Car-hacking chain (hardcoded API keys -> WAF bypass -> MFA skip) that unlocks/starts vehicles from number plates across AU/US/Canada, and the WAF-bypass path was found by turning an LLM loose on the source for ~6 hours.
key_facts: Chain: hardcoded admin API keys in a JS bundle -> ForgeRock OpenIDM path traversal bypassing a WAF -> Australian MFA-skip via ROPC flow accepted by the vehicle command API
GPT 5.6 Sol Ultra, given OpenIDM source and run ~6 hours, found the unblocked path /static%2f..%2fopenidm/ that manual testing had missed
Exposed data: emails, names, phone numbers, password/PIN hashes, push tokens; account takeover via password overwrite
Companion research extended remote unlock/start to US and Canada; automaker and brand are anonymized

stories.title: wici-ai/inferssd
stories.reason: Concrete inference-serving trick (streaming MoE experts from SSD on top of llama.cpp) with vendor-measured but specific multi-x speedups across several machines.
key_facts: InferSSD streams MoE experts from SSD so models bigger than RAM/VRAM run, built on llama.cpp/GGUF, Apache-2.0
DeepSeek on RTX 5090: 20.4x faster prefill, 8.4x faster decode vs llama.cpp
DeepSeek on DGX Spark: 46.7x faster prefill, 4.5x faster decode vs llama.cpp
Supports DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, Muse-Spark-Open, Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on macOS/Metal and Linux/CUDA

stories.title: Show HN: We compressed a 31B video+audio diffusion model to 14B, 6 steps, INT8
stories.reason: Real compression result on a video+audio diffusion model with both code and weights released and concrete speed numbers, not just a benchmark claim.
key_facts: HyperFlow H3 Flash compresses MiniMax-H3 (~31B) to ~13.7-13.9B via block pruning, low-rank factorization and rotated W8A8 INT8 quantization
Supports 4-8 step sampling via two-time (t,r) conditioning, down from the base model's step count
5.2s clip at 1344x768, 6 steps: 8.7s on 4xB200, 36s on 1xH200, 92s on 1xRTX5090; Q4_K_M GGUF (9.1GB) runs on 24-32GB consumer GPUs
Code is Apache-2.0/GPL-3.0/MIT across components; weights use MiniMax's non-OSI community license with regional use restrictions

stories.title: microsoft/TokenEconomizer
stories.reason: Microsoft's black-box cost-control plugin for coding agents has real SWE-Bench numbers (18-31% cost cut, pass@1 mostly flat-to-up) rather than a bare announcement.
key_facts: Cuts coding-agent cost via repo-learned micro-skills, unused-tool pruning, and a loop-guard for stuck turns, without touching the model
SWE-Bench, 277 tasks x 6 repos x 5 agent/model combos: 18.4-30.9% lower mean cost, cheaper in all 30 cells
Pass@1 rose in 4 of 5 combos (+0.9 to +2.6), fell 1.0 in one (Opus 4.8)
Web-Bench 16-21% cheaper, two security-auditing benchmarks 6-20% cheaper; works via existing agent hooks/settings, fully reversible

stories.title: Goodbye Claude, hello Pi
stories.reason: Widely discussed (406 comments) critique of Claude Code's overhead/release cadence from a dev switching to the open-source Pi harness; useful harness-design signal even though it's one person's opinion.
key_facts: 244 Claude Code releases this year; >75% changed the system prompt or tool descriptions
Default Bash tool description is ~3,000 tokens, mostly unneeded git/PR instructions
Switch driven by VS Code integration bugs, feature bloat (agent teams, dynamic workflows) and lack of AGENTS.md support at the time
